title: Primary lockup
slide_intent: Teach designers how to signal that an externally visible program belongs to a parent brand. A full signature can establish that relationship for an unfamiliar audience.
strategic_value: Slack can lend recognition to public programs, events and groups by carrying its full logo into their names.
demonstration: The complete Slack logo stands beside the sample entity name “primary.” A second drawing directly beneath it overlays spacing guides on the same lockup.
practical_value: Use this construction for a high-visibility external entity. Set its name in lowercase Hellix Regular with optical kerning and −10 tracking, separated by the indicated A unit.

content_islands.name: Audience and construction
content_islands.spec: Put two short paragraphs at left, first explaining which entities use this form and then giving the typography and spacing.

content_islands.name: Clean primary lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the colored octothorpe and black Slack wordmark beside the thinner entity name in the upper right.
